1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.f3 dxe4 4.fxe4 e5 5.Nf.strategy: Develops with an attack on e5, meeting Black's central strike with piece pressure instead of settling the tension. Black has nothing to defend e5 yet, so it must exchange or support the pawn, while White keeps the better development.

Takes on d4 and opens the centre, but leaves the king in the middle and hands White the initiative. The extra pawn is only borrowed: d4 is attacked twice, and the open diagonals against f7 and the open f-file make delay dangerous.
